# AI data centers are scaling fast. Let's build them the right way.

Water is at the heart of AI. You need water to produce chips, to power them, and to cool them. There
is no AI without water. And today, that matters more than ever.

## protecting people and the resources vital to life.

People Health

Helping people thrive by protecting their individual health, the food they eat and the spaces where
they live and work.

Planet Health

Helping the planet thrive by protecting the earth's climate and its most valuable resource: water.

Business Health

Helping businesses thrive by protecting their reputations and their bottom line.

our eROI counter to see how much water, energy, waste and air is positively impacted by customers
using our technologies.

# Unilever Global

[Close ][66]

## Summary

A range of Unilever products being used, as well as advertising lifestyle imagery. Text throughout
the video reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3
steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at
Scale.”

## Detailed description

The video begins with a close-up of a woman with curly hair adorned with gold bows smiling directly
into the camera. Her hands move toward the lens, briefly obscuring the view as she frames her face.
She wears a soft, light-toned top and has bright blue nail polish, creating a vibrant contrast
against her skin. The text “Unilever is home” appears, suggesting the start of a message about the
company. The frame pans out to show the woman is wearing an off-shoulder dress and standing in a
grand, ornate room. Several other people are visible in the background in a masked ball setting in
an elaborate regency-style room.

The next frame shows a close-up of a revolving jar of Dove 10-in-1 Serum Mask Intensive Repair. The
jar is white with a gold-coloured lid, and the background is silvery grey. The overlaid text sitting
to the left of the product, which reads “to some of the world’s”, continues the message from the
previous screen.

The scene cuts to a refrigerator interior shot. A bottle of Hellmann’s Spicy Mayonnaise stands
upright in the centre, surrounded by fresh ingredients such as tomatoes and red peppers. Bold blue
text, which reads “most iconic”, overlays the image.

The frame then switches to a close-up of a hand lifting a white piece of fabric in iridescent pastel
lighting, with soft-focus people in the background. The person’s reflection is visible on the sheet.
The words “and beloved” are overlaid, and the Vaseline logo appears in the top corner.

Next, the camera transitions to a Persil Wonder Wash detergent bottle, angled dynamically with water
droplets against a clean, blue-toned background. The word “brands” appears on screen.

The video then cuts to an overhead shot of a jar of smooth white cream. A hand with red nail polish
uses a small spatula to scoop some of the cream. The words “We’re staying” appear over the product.

The next frame shows a close-up of smooth gel-like cream in soft peach tones, with the number “1”
overlaid. This is followed by an abstract close-up of liquid bubbles on a blue background, with the
number “2” overlaid. And then a close-up of fresh lime slices against a white background, with the
number “3” overlaid. Next, the video zooms in on hands holding a small gold box against a light
background, casting a soft shadow. The words “steps ahead” appear over the box.

A close-up shot of fine red powder dispersing across a white background appears, creating a
textured, granular effect. The word “Transforming” appears over the image.

This is followed by a close-up of orange powder dispersing against a dark green background, with the
word “into” overlaid.

A new frame comes into view featuring three women standing shoulder to shoulder, smiling confidently
at the camera. They are diverse in appearance: one with short, curly hair; one with long, dark curly
hair; and one with straight, light brown hair. One woman has a visible arm tattoo. Overlaid text
reads: “a Marketing & Sales machine”.

The next frame shows a woman in a black beret and black-and-white striped jacket, wearing a red
necklace, eating cherries in a warm, soft-focus interior. The words “With SASSY brands” appear
beside her.

A stylised split-screen scene appears. Two women pose in elegant, black outfits within circular
frames. Both are holding a perfume bottle. The word “creating” repeats across the screen. The brand
name Nexxus appears at the bottom.

The screen focuses in on a woman with long, glossy dark hair and red lipstick, wearing a red coat
against a dark background with falling droplets. The word “Desire” is overlaid prominently.

This is followed by a close-up of two Nexxus bottles positioned diagonally against a black
background, partially visible at opposite corners, with the word “at” centred between them.

The next frame shows a Vaseline Gluta-Hya lip serum tube in cherry colour, positioned among large,
glossy red spheres against a light background. The word “Scale” appears prominently on the left.

Finally, the video switches into a soft, gradient background blending pastel shades of blue, purple
and pink. At the centre sits the Unilever logo, with the words “Desire at Scale”.

Across all the frames, the wording in its entirety reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s
most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3 steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales
machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at Scale.”

No audio and no captions available

Business Groups

## The world’s best-known brands creating Desire at Scale

Our brands touch billions of lives every day.

[A woman smiles as she rubs cream into her bare shoulder.]

### [Beauty & Wellbeing][67]

No more trade-offs. No more compromises. Just beauty and wellbeing as one.

[A man dressed for the gym confidently applies deodorant to his underarm.]

### [Personal Care][68]

Powering up Personal Care, developing superior products with breakthrough science and technology.

[A woman pulls her cosy sweater up over her face to below her glinting eyes.]

### [Home Care][69]

Delivering joyful cleaning experiences for people everywhere.

[Person holding a crispy chicken sandwich with lettuce and pickles.]

### [Foods][70]

For the love of food – great taste is at the heart of everything we do.

[A close-up display of various hair and skincare products arranged on a reflective surface,
including Dove Bond Strength conditioner, TRESemmé Silk Press serum, TRESemmé Lamellar Gloss
finishing oil, and other branded items in the background.]

Unilever LinkedIn

## On social media

Latest conversations, announcements and insights.

[Elfried Samba wears a wide-brimmed hat standing in front of a large FIFA World Cup 2026™ football
pop up.]

### [Elfried Samba goes inside our FIFA World Cup 2026™ activation (Opens in new modal)][71]

[Close ][72]

(1 of 10)

## Elfried Samba goes inside our FIFA World Cup 2026™ activation

JavaScript must be enabled to view this content

We invited Elfried Samba, a leading voice on creators and community, to join us behind the scenes at
the FIFA World Cup 2026™, where Unilever is the Official Personal Care Sponsor.

His verdict? Our biggest-ever sports activation puts creators at its centre, giving them experiences
that are too good not to post – a move that sparks authentic content and makes a global event feel

## Summary

A range of Unilever products being used, as well as advertising lifestyle imagery. Text throughout
the video reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3
steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at
Scale.”

## Detailed description

The video begins with a close-up of a woman with curly hair adorned with gold bows smiling directly
into the camera. Her hands move toward the lens, briefly obscuring the view as she frames her face.
She wears a soft, light-toned top and has bright blue nail polish, creating a vibrant contrast
against her skin. The text “Unilever is home” appears, suggesting the start of a message about the
company. The frame pans out to show the woman is wearing an off-shoulder dress and standing in a
grand, ornate room. Several other people are visible in the background in a masked ball setting in
an elaborate regency-style room.

The next frame shows a close-up of a revolving jar of Dove 10-in-1 Serum Mask Intensive Repair. The
jar is white with a gold-coloured lid, and the background is silvery grey. The overlaid text sitting
to the left of the product, which reads “to some of the world’s”, continues the message from the
previous screen.

The scene cuts to a refrigerator interior shot. A bottle of Hellmann’s Spicy Mayonnaise stands
upright in the centre, surrounded by fresh ingredients such as tomatoes and red peppers. Bold blue
text, which reads “most iconic”, overlays the image.

The frame then switches to a close-up of a hand lifting a white piece of fabric in iridescent pastel
lighting, with soft-focus people in the background. The person’s reflection is visible on the sheet.
The words “and beloved” are overlaid, and the Vaseline logo appears in the top corner.

Next, the camera transitions to a Persil Wonder Wash detergent bottle, angled dynamically with water
droplets against a clean, blue-toned background. The word “brands” appears on screen.

The video then cuts to an overhead shot of a jar of smooth white cream. A hand with red nail polish
uses a small spatula to scoop some of the cream. The words “We’re staying” appear over the product.

The next frame shows a close-up of smooth gel-like cream in soft peach tones, with the number “1”
overlaid. This is followed by an abstract close-up of liquid bubbles on a blue background, with the
number “2” overlaid. And then a close-up of fresh lime slices against a white background, with the
number “3” overlaid. Next, the video zooms in on hands holding a small gold box against a light
background, casting a soft shadow. The words “steps ahead” appear over the box.

A close-up shot of fine red powder dispersing across a white background appears, creating a
textured, granular effect. The word “Transforming” appears over the image.

This is followed by a close-up of orange powder dispersing against a dark green background, with the
word “into” overlaid.

A new frame comes into view featuring three women standing shoulder to shoulder, smiling confidently
at the camera. They are diverse in appearance: one with short, curly hair; one with long, dark curly
hair; and one with straight, light brown hair. One woman has a visible arm tattoo. Overlaid text
reads: “a Marketing & Sales machine”.

The next frame shows a woman in a black beret and black-and-white striped jacket, wearing a red
necklace, eating cherries in a warm, soft-focus interior. The words “With SASSY brands” appear
beside her.

A stylised split-screen scene appears. Two women pose in elegant, black outfits within circular
frames. Both are holding a perfume bottle. The word “creating” repeats across the screen. The brand
name Nexxus appears at the bottom.

The screen focuses in on a woman with long, glossy dark hair and red lipstick, wearing a red coat
against a dark background with falling droplets. The word “Desire” is overlaid prominently.

This is followed by a close-up of two Nexxus bottles positioned diagonally against a black
background, partially visible at opposite corners, with the word “at” centred between them.

The next frame shows a Vaseline Gluta-Hya lip serum tube in cherry colour, positioned among large,
glossy red spheres against a light background. The word “Scale” appears prominently on the left.

Finally, the video switches into a soft, gradient background blending pastel shades of blue, purple
and pink. At the centre sits the Unilever logo, with the words “Desire at Scale”.

Across all the frames, the wording in its entirety reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s
most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3 steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales
machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at Scale.”

No audio and no captions available

the best to our customers. From raw material sourcing to final packaging, every step is governed by
our ISO 13485-certified quality management system.

### Global Responsibility

We aim to contribute positively to public health, environmental sustainability, and social
well-being through our products and practices. Our ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications reflect
our genuine commitment to a safer, greener future for all.

market access for every product we produce.

Full compliance with European medical device directives, granting access to the EU market and
confirming our products meet rigorous European safety standards.

⚙️

### ISO 13485

International standard for quality management systems specific to medical device manufacturers,
ensuring consistent product safety and regulatory compliance worldwide.

🌿

### ISO 14001

Environmental management certification demonstrating our commitment to minimizing ecological impact
and operating sustainably across all manufacturing activities.

🛡️

### ISO 45001

Occupational health and safety management certification, ensuring a safe and healthy workplace for
all employees and stakeholders throughout our operations.

— meeting the demands of global healthcare supply chains.

cleanroom protocols. Every production line is monitored in real time to guarantee product
consistency, traceability, and compliance with international medical device regulations.

ISO-classified cleanroom environments for sterile product manufacturing

🤖 **Full Automation**

Fully automated production lines minimizing human error and maximizing output

🔍 **In-Line QC**

Real-time quality inspection at every stage of the production process

📦 **Sterile Packaging**

Advanced sterile packaging systems ensuring product integrity during transit

Medical as their preferred supplier.

experience translates into superior product design, robust processes, and reliable delivery — every
single time.

💡

develop new materials, needle geometries, and suture formulations that improve surgical outcomes and
reduce complications.

✅

accepted in markets across Europe, Asia, the Americas, and beyond — giving you confidence in every
order.

minimal defect rates. This technological advantage allows us to fulfill large-volume orders with
precision and speed.

🌍

We have established strong partnerships with distributors and healthcare institutions in over 50
countries. Our global logistics infrastructure ensures timely delivery and responsive after-sales
support wherever you are.

# We don't just collect waste. We transform materials.

We’re a leading provider of recycling and resource recovery solutions across the UK and Ireland. By
tackling our customers’ environmental challenges and transforming hard to handle materials, we
protect and recover the world’s finite resources.

[Discover more about Enva][294]

## GMP News

06.07.2026

[Revised Annex 19 on Reference and Retention Samples][189]

The European Commission has published a revised version of Annex 19 of EudraLex Volume 4, allowing
photographic or digital records as an alternative to physical retention samples for parallel traded
products. The new version is applicable from 24 September 2026.

[Read more][190]

06.07.2026

[How to (not) use AI for GxP Inspection Responses][191]

In a recent blog post, the U.K. MHRA has outlined examples of responses to inspection reports that
were generated by artificial intelligence (AI), which, in some cases, contain alarming errors.

[Read more][192]

06.07.2026

[Q&As on "GMP meets AI - How to Use Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality
Control"][193]

In February, more than 80 people participated in the Live Online Training organized by the ECA on
the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality Control. During the Q&A
sessions, numerous interesting questions were asked, which were answered by the presenters. We have
compiled a selection of these questions and answers for you.

[Read more][194]

## GMP News

06.07.2026

[Revised Annex 19 on Reference and Retention Samples][189]

The European Commission has published a revised version of Annex 19 of EudraLex Volume 4, allowing
photographic or digital records as an alternative to physical retention samples for parallel traded
products. The new version is applicable from 24 September 2026.

[Read more][190]

06.07.2026

[How to (not) use AI for GxP Inspection Responses][191]

In a recent blog post, the U.K. MHRA has outlined examples of responses to inspection reports that
were generated by artificial intelligence (AI), which, in some cases, contain alarming errors.

[Read more][192]

06.07.2026

[Q&As on "GMP meets AI - How to Use Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality
Control"][193]

In February, more than 80 people participated in the Live Online Training organized by the ECA on
the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality Control. During the Q&A
sessions, numerous interesting questions were asked, which were answered by the presenters. We have
compiled a selection of these questions and answers for you.

[Read more][194]

takeaways, not hot takes.

infection preventionists must speak up. In this exclusive ICT interview, she shares lessons from a
tumultuous year and her vision for strengthening the infection prevention profession worldwide.

grow, and what it will take to build a stronger workforce. Expect curiosity, honesty, and practical
takeaways, not hot takes.

put on the most important thing: Getting the Patient Better.

# Your Partner in Infection Prevention Since 1985

Our solutions are trusted every day in thousands of healthcare facilities around the world to help
prevent infections and cross-contamination.

[ Learn More ][58]

### CaviCide™ HP

CaviCide™ HP a ready-to-use liquid surface disinfectant utilizing a hydrogen peroxide formulation
that offers a universal 1-minute contact time against all 70 listed pathogens and meets all levels
of the EPA’s rigorous Emerging Viral Pathogen (EVP) claim.

[ Learn More ][59]

##### About Us

## Who We Are

We believe that NO ONE should ever have to fight for their health over an illness they did not have
when they entered a healthcare facility. We work tirelessly to ensure that all people within all
areas of the healthcare environment are properly protected from cross-contamination so focus can be
put on the most important thing: Getting the Patient Better.

[ Learn More ][60]

THE CLEAR ALIGNER SYSTEM BUILT FOR YOUR PRACTICE

## Spark™ Clear Aligners

Spark Clear Aligners are trusted by professionals worldwide to deliver more precise, more efficient
treatment — from first scan to final smile.
 
* Powered by TruGen™ material for clearer, more comfortable and sustained force retention
* Backed by Spark™ Approver Software for streamlined digital workflows
* 100% patient recommendation rate in surveys^{*}
* Integrated features like BiteSync™ and TruRoot™ for complex cases
   

[ Learn More ][123] [ Request a Demo ][124]
[Open aligner case with a clear aligner and built‑in mirror on a blue accent background.]
[Close-up view of a metallic Damon Ultima orthodontic bracket.]

THE FIRST FULL EXPRESSION ORTHODONTIC SYSTEM

## Damon Ultima™ System

Engineered for earlier control and more precise finishing, Damon Ultima is the first true
full-expression orthodontic system. Its reimagined bracket and wire design virtually eliminates play
— for faster, more predictable results with lighter forces.^{*}
 
* Four points of contact for precise torque, angulation, and rotation
* Round-sided rectangular wires for earlier control
* Easy ligation and low-force door closure
* Built-in enhancements for patient comfort and efficient workflow
   

[ Learn More ][125] [ Request a Demo ][126]

TWO OF ORMCO'S BEST-IN-CLASS SOLUTIONS COMBINED

## Ormco™ Digital Bonding

An indirect digital bonding system, powered by Spark technology, that combines Spark Approver
Software, custom jigs and a growing portfolio of brackets into one seamless digital workflow. It is
designed to simplify planning, reduce steps, and give orthodontists earlier control over treatment.
 
* Accurate, customized bracket placement for more efficient treatment and predictable outcomes
* Advanced digital treatment planning with pre‑ and post‑treatment visualization
* Greater clinical flexibility through expanded bracket options for a wider range of cases with
  tailored approaches
   

[ Learn More ][127] [ Request A Demo ][128]
[Transparent indirect bonding tray with preloaded metal orthodontic brackets positioned over a
dental arch.]

FAQS

## Have a question? We're here to help.

What products and solutions does Ormco specialize in?
Open menu

Ormco specializes in a wide range of orthodontic products and systems, including:
* Brackets & Wires - Featuring the [Damon Ultima System][133], [Damon Q2][134], [Insignia][135],^{™}
  [Symetri^{™} Clear][136], and a variety of traditional and self-ligating bracket systems.
* Clear Aligners - [Spark Clear Aligners][137] with TruGEN^{™} material and [Spark^{™} Approver
  Software][138] for precision case planning.
* [Ormco Digital Bonding][139] - A digital indirect bonding system using Spark Approver software and
  Ormco Jigs for accurate, efficient bracket placement.
* Retention - [Spark Retainers][140] use TruGEN^{™} technology, the same technology that powers
  Spark^{™} Clear Aligners, Spark Retainers deliver similar superior clarity and stain resistance.

These solutions are designed to streamline treatment, increase precision, and improve patient
satisfaction.

Which appliances are essential for a modern orthodontic practice?
Open menu

Essential orthodontic appliances include high-quality brackets, archwires, bonding agents, and
digital scanners. Ormco offers a full line of premium orthodontic appliances and accessories
engineered for precision, durability, and compatibility with today’s advanced treatment systems,
such as Damon^{™} and Spark^{™}.

What clinical training and education does Ormco offer?

their teams. These include live events, virtual webinars, and on-demand courses. Our courses are led
by experienced orthodontists and clinical educators, helping providers stay up to date with the
latest innovations and techniques in orthodontics.

Using our surface disinfectants not only protects you and your patients from pathogens, but also

laboratory, where over 20,000 disinfection cycles were simulated in extensive tests in accordance

# Global Experts in Wet Wipes

For over 60 years PDI Contract Manufacturing has partnered with leading consumer brands and pharma
companies to deliver products in alternate delivery systems. Focusing on the highest level of
quality, let PDI’s expertise work for you.

[ Our Capabilities ][33]

## Markets We Serve

[

### Pharmaceutical Market

We offer topical drug delivery systems that patients prefer and provide a more targeted, localized
drug delivery. Increase your brand revenue by extending the brand lifecycle.

### Over-The-Counter Market

Wipes are a perfect way to extend your current OTC brand or create a new one. We specialize in drug
manufacturing throughout the healthcare and consumer marketplace.

Learn More

[PDI Contract Manufacturing Image]
[PDI Contract Manufacturing Icon]

### Consumer Market

Wipes are a part of health, beauty, and personal care routines. Our library of formulas and
non-wovens can help build the products your customers are looking for.

Learn More

[USManufacturing_400x400]
* [PDI Contract Manufacturing Icon]PartnershipOur approach is to create partnerships for long term
  successful relationships. Let us help you extend your brand and build your future.
* [PDI Contract Manufacturing Icon]QualityWe have sites in the United States that are FDA
  registered, ISO certified and follow cGMP guidelines for the manufacturing of OTC, Rx, Medical
  Device and Cosmetic wipes.
* [PDI Contract Manufacturing Icon]ExpertiseFounded in 1957 as Nice-Pak Products with the vision
  that pre-moistened wet wipes were the optimal delivery system for both consumer and healthcare
  products, we continue to lead in innovation and quality manufacturing in almost every imaginable
  format of premoisented applicators.
* [PDI Contract Manufacturing Icon]Dedicated Project SupportLet our team of experts take the worry
  out of your project. We are a full service turnkey organization and have subject matter experts in
  validation, non-wovens, formulations, regulatory, manufacturing and project management, quality
  and customer support.

## Why Wet Wipes

The industry trend for topical product formats.

##### Controlled Delivery

## Ease of Use

The right amount of solution delivered to the right location, easier and safer for consumers and
patients.

##### Convenience

## Portability

On the go, no need to worry. Convenient, portable, hygienic, premeasured.

## Wasserdesinfektion

Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel gehören durch die Nutzung von speziell stabilisierten und
wirkungsverstärktem Wasserstoffperoxid zu den effektivsten Produkten in diesem Bereich

Die Wirkung vor allem gegenüber Biofilmen, Schleimablagerungen und VBNC Keimen ist dem oft
verwendeten Chlor und Chlordioxid klar und nachweislich überlegen. Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel sind
verglichen mit anderen oxidierenden Bioziden im Wasser auch deutlich länger aktiv und ermöglichen
die Verwendung in langen Leitungssystemen. Es können deshalb tiefere wirksame Konzentrationen
eingesetzt werden, welche dadurch deutlich geringere Korrosionsraten aufweisen. Dies schont
Material, Umwelt und reduziert laufende Kosten. Ein besonderer Pluspunkt der Sanosil
Desinfektionsmittel ist zudem die gute Umweltverträglichkeit des Wirkstoffes Wasserstoffperoxid.
Dieses zersetzt sich während der Desinfektion komplett zu Wasser und Sauerstoff, und im Gegensatz zu
Brom oder Chlor werden keine giftigen Trihalomethane gebildet.


[Disinfected table in a hospital]


## Flächendesinfektion

Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel hinterlassen durch die geringen Menge an Feststoffen auch bei
wiederholtem Einsatz keine klebrigen Rückstände auf den desinfizierten Flächen

Das geboostete Wasserstoffperoxid zerfällt nach der Anwendung zu Wasser und Sauerstoff und weist
deshalb eine gute Umweltverträglichkeit auf. Es werden weder Desinfektionsmittel-, noch
Antibiotikaresistenzen begünstigt. Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel verbreiten auch keine unangenehm
riechende oder gar brennbare Dämpfe.

Die meisten Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel verfügen zudem über eine gewisse Depotwirkung, wodurch die
rasche Wiederverkeimung auf Oberflächen deutlich gehemmt gehemmt wird. Dies macht die Sanosil
Flächen – Desinfektionsmittel zur ideale Wahl für gewerbliche und private Anwender.

[Square---Google-display-ads-V-2]

## Aerosol – Raumdesinfektion

Die Aerosolanwendung ist eine Methode der automatisierten Desinfektion von ganzen Räumen über die
Luft

Dabei werden Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel mit einem geeigneten Gerät automatisch in winzig kleine
Tröpfchen zerstäubt. Diese Aerosole bedecken anschliessend lückenlos alle Oberflächen. So können
gefährliche Lücken geschlossen und die Wirkung der klassische manuelle Sprüh und -Wischdesinfektion
ideal ergänzt werden. Diese Kombination hat sich als eine der wirkungsvollsten Methoden im Kampf
gegen resistente Keime und Krankenhausinfektionen erwiesen.

Auch in der Pharmaindustrie / Reinräumen wird die Verwendung automatisierter, luftgetragener
Desinfektionssysteme im EU GMP Annex 1 explizit erwähnt. Die Anwendung ist aber nicht auf den
Medizin – und Pharmabereich beschränkt. Aerosoldesinfektionen sorgen auch in Hotelräumen, Labors,
Fahrzeugen sowie in Grossraumbüros und Konferenzsäälen für zusätzliche Hygiene und Reduktion
ansteckender Krankheiten.


Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel für die Aerosoldesinfektion bestechen vorallem durch ihr katalytisch
leistungsgesteigertes Wasserstoffperoxid. Deshalb sind sie Systemen mit
Heissdampf-Wasserstoffperoxid, welche deutlich stärkere H2O2 Konzentrationen  verwenden, ebenbürtig.

## What is ViralFX™?

Modern healthcare and public health continue to advance at a breath-taking rate.
Yet infectious bacterial and viral diseases still present an enormous threat to all of us.

Livestock Disinfection has been in use ever since 1867 as “Phenol”, Hypochlorite’s (Bleaches) since
second half of the 19 th century. The new approach to disinfection (Chlorhexidine) was introduced in
1949 and the modern infection control Virkon® (ViralFX™) being the ideal disinfectant for the
1990’s.

ViralFX™ is the most advanced antibacterial, antiviral livestock farm / animal disinfectant. It is
one of the first oxidative disinfectants to be used on the livestock farm and continues to lead the
way in livestock production and farm biosecurity, having been deployed successfully against 500
disease-causing pathogens.

[

][168]
[Farm disinfectant, bio-degradable, livestock antibacterial]

### Eco
### Friendly

ViralFX™ is environmentally safe and completely biodegradable. ViralFX™ is an oxygen based
disinfectant, containing simple inorganic salts and organic acids which decompose into harmless
metabolites in the process..
[

[Proven Broad Spectrum antibacterial, antiviral farm disinfectant]

### Broad
### Specturm

ViralFX™ is effective against numerous microorganisms affecting animals: viruses, gram +ve and gram
-ve bacteria, fungi (molds and yeasts), and mycoplasma. ViralFX™ Effective against several Animal
Zoonotic pathogens.
[
Download ViralFX™
][170]
[Non corrosive, biodegradable bio-disinfectant for bio-security]

### Non
### corrosive

Hypochlorite(Bleach) Solution are highly corrosive to metal surfaces and will also adversely affect
other materials such as silicone sealants. ViralFX™ powder is corrosive. However, once diluted in
water becomes non-corrosive.

[Compatible, safe farm bio disinfectant]

### Compatible
### Formula

ViralFX™ is compatible with a wide range of materials including stainless steel, plastics & rubber.
Corrosivity trials were performed according to the British Crop Protection Council Testing Scheme
using a 1% ViralFX™ ..

is a multi-purpose disinfectant.

## What is ViralFX™?

Modern healthcare and public health continue to advance at a breath-taking rate.
Yet infectious bacterial and viral diseases still present an enormous threat to all of us.

Livestock Disinfection has been in use ever since 1867 as “Phenol”, Hypochlorite’s (Bleaches) since
second half of the 19 th century. The new approach to disinfection (Chlorhexidine) was introduced in
1949 and the modern infection control Virkon® (ViralFX™) being the ideal disinfectant for the
1990’s.

ViralFX™ is the most advanced antibacterial, antiviral livestock farm / animal disinfectant. It is
one of the first oxidative disinfectants to be used on the livestock farm and continues to lead the
way in livestock production and farm biosecurity, having been deployed successfully against 500
disease-causing pathogens.

[
Read more
][168]
[Farm disinfectant, bio-degradable, livestock antibacterial]

### Eco
### Friendly

ViralFX™ is environmentally safe and completely biodegradable. ViralFX™ is an oxygen based
disinfectant, containing simple inorganic salts and organic acids which decompose into harmless
metabolites in the process..
[
Read More
][169]
[Proven Broad Spectrum antibacterial, antiviral farm disinfectant]

### Broad
### Specturm

ViralFX™ is effective against numerous microorganisms affecting animals: viruses, gram +ve and gram
-ve bacteria, fungi (molds and yeasts), and mycoplasma. ViralFX™ Effective against several Animal
Zoonotic pathogens.
[
Download ViralFX™
][170]
[Non corrosive, biodegradable bio-disinfectant for bio-security]

### Non
### corrosive

Hypochlorite(Bleach) Solution are highly corrosive to metal surfaces and will also adversely affect
other materials such as silicone sealants. ViralFX™ powder is corrosive. However, once diluted in
water becomes non-corrosive.
[
Read More
][171]
[Compatible, safe farm bio disinfectant]

### Compatible
### Formula

ViralFX™ is compatible with a wide range of materials including stainless steel, plastics & rubber.
Corrosivity trials were performed according to the British Crop Protection Council Testing Scheme
using a 1% ViralFX™ ..
[
Read More
][172]
[APVMA approved farm bio disinfectant antibacterial anti viral disinfection]

### APVMA
### REGISTERED

ViralFX™ is a registered product with Australian Pesticides and Veterinary Medicine Authority
(APVMA) licensee product for routine day to day disinfection and Emergency Disease Control. ViralFX™
is a multi-purpose disinfectant.

### You’ve got enough on your plate…
### who has time for bugs?

With lasting germ protection for hands and surfaces, ZOONO^{®} lets you enjoy
 sharing precious moments – without stressing about picking up a bug.

### How does ZOONO^{®}
### work?

Up close, the ZOONO^{®} shield looks like a layer of tiny pins that
cover a surface.

When germs touch the surface, they pop and are destroyed.
What’s more, this clever popping action has been proven effective on **99.9% of bacteria and wide
range of pathogens.**

[DISCOVER HOW][76]

### STEP 01

ZOONO^{®} works by coating the surface with a
layer of positively charged molecular pins.

### STEP 02

Protective layer attaches to the surface using a covalent bond which then attracts and kills
negatively charged pathogens by rupturing their cells.

### STEP 03

When pathogens touch the surface, they pop and are destroyed, which means they can’t affect you and
they can’t evolve into superbugs.

### STEP 04

What’s more, this clever popping action is effective on 99.9% of bacteria and has also been proven
against a range of viruses.

### NEXT LEVEL GERM PROTECTION, FOR THE PEOPLE YOU LOVE

### Long-Lasting

ZOONO^{®}'s protective shield kills 99.9%
of germs on the skin and surface for
extended periods.

[icon_1__PID:897fe02f-5c09-40d6-a9c0-6f776c0dfaf2]

### Pleasant To Use

Our water-based, alcohol free products
can be used by all, and our hand
sanitizer has been dermatologically tested

### Scientifically Proven

ZOONO^{®}'s innovative germ popping tech
is proven effective against a wide range of
bacteria and other pathogens

### You’ve got enough on your plate…
### who has time for bugs?

With lasting germ protection for hands and surfaces, ZOONO^{®} lets you enjoy
 sharing precious moments – without stressing about picking up a bug.

### How does ZOONO^{®}
### work?

Up close, the ZOONO^{®} shield looks like a layer of tiny pins that
cover a surface.

When germs touch the surface, they pop and are destroyed.
What’s more, this clever popping action has been proven effective on **99.9% of bacteria and wide
range of pathogens.**

[DISCOVER HOW][76]

### STEP 01

ZOONO^{®} works by coating the surface with a
layer of positively charged molecular pins.

### STEP 02

Protective layer attaches to the surface using a covalent bond which then attracts and kills
negatively charged pathogens by rupturing their cells.

### STEP 03

When pathogens touch the surface, they pop and are destroyed, which means they can’t affect you and
they can’t evolve into superbugs.

### STEP 04

What’s more, this clever popping action is effective on 99.9% of bacteria and has also been proven
against a range of viruses.
